title: Holloway Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency hospitals, urgent care facilities, local hazards, and critical supplies for Holloway.
content:
For life-threatening emergencies, call 999 or 112 immediately.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals:
- Whittington Hospital: Magdala Avenue, N19 5NF. From Archway station: ~5 min walk east along Junction Road and Magdala Avenue (~400 metres). From Holloway Road station: ~25 min walk north along Holloway Road and Junction Road (~1.3 miles), or take bus 43, 17, or 271 north directly to the hospital entrance (~15 mins).
- University College Hospital (UCH): 235 Euston Road, NW1 2BU. From Caledonian Road station: ~35 min walk south along Caledonian Road and Pentonville Road, or take bus 91 south towards Euston (~20 mins).
- Royal Free Hospital: Pond Street, NW3 2QG. From Archway station: ~35 min walk west via Highgate Hill and Dartmouth Park Hill, or take bus C11 west towards Hampstead Heath (~20 mins).

2. NHS Urgent Treatment Centres (UTC):
- Whittington Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre: Magdala Avenue, N19 5NF (located alongside the main A&E department; walk from Archway station or take bus 43 from Holloway Road).

3. Local Hazards & Flood Risks:
- No major open waterways in central Holloway, but significant surface water flooding risk exists under railway bridges on Holloway Road, Caledonian Road, and Benwell Road during intense storms.
- The Western and Northern mainline rail cuttings create localized access choke points during flash flooding.

4. Supplies & Essentials:
Pharmacies and large supermarkets along Holloway Road, Seven Sisters Road, and Caledonian Road provide bottled drinking water, batteries, hygiene supplies, and essential medications during network outages.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
